cases.stands_for: Switching between cards back and forth always shows the clicked card's video, not a stale one.
cases.observed: Initial: C1 selected, visible player c1.webm (6.88s). Click card 2 (C2, 0:08): visible player c2.webm (7.68s), claim panel C2. Click card 1 (C1, 0:07): visible c1.webm. Click card 2 again: visible c2.webm, 0:01/0:08. Each source matched the clicked card's claim. The highlighted card was not exposed in the tree beyond [active] on the clicked item; the claim panel shown matched the clicked card (C2 after the card-2 click).
